title: Chapter 450: Subjugating Maris
content:
Chapter 450: Subjugating Maris

Maris, who was smashed into the deep pit, was already dying.

He endured the severe pain, cheered up, and said weakly: "Don't kill me."

Wang Shuo jumped off the dragon's body and came to the dragon's head.

"Give me a reason."

"I can be your pet."

Maris's desire to survive was full.

Wang Shuo hesitated. This was indeed an irresistible temptation.

A genuine and strongest king monster.

If he surrendered, it would be very easy for Wang Shuo to conquer the Wagyan Empire.

If Maris was killed, he would have to fight him bit by bit.

After thinking for a while, Wang Shuo agreed to Maris's request.

"Then let's sign the contract!"

"Can you treat me first? I can't even turn into a human form now."

Wang Shuo carefully checked Maris's injuries and found that he was indeed seriously injured, so he asked: "How can I recover your injuries?"

"I need energy, flesh, soul and other things."

Wang Shuo looked at Mikhail in the distance: "Is your subordinate okay?"

"Yes."

So, Wang Shuo, Zhao Bangde and others, quickly subdued Mikhail who was fighting against the Ice Phoenix Emperor.

Seeing that he was caught in front of Maris, he knew what they wanted to do without thinking.

Mikhail also begged for mercy.

But Maris didn't give him more chances to speak, and swallowed him directly.

A Star Glory boss can only restore him to 10% of his strength at most.

Half an hour later, Maris struggled to get up. He is now considering whether to take the opportunity to escape.

After a careful estimate, there are 11 high-level warriors around him.

He was surrounded, and there was no chance for him to escape.

With a sigh, Maris had to accept his fate.

He summoned the magic circle and became Wang Shuo's third pet.

"Meet the master."

Maris regained his human form, but he was very weak and hunched over.

Since he had become Wang Shuo's pet.

Wang Shuo decided to give him the Water of Life to recover from his injuries.

When he saw the Water of Life, Maris showed an incredible expression.

With the Water of Life, he quickly recovered to his peak strength.

At this time, Maris still had important things to do.

Order all the demons to surrender.

Half an hour ago, Maris fought with his last breath and ordered the demons to stop the attack and retreat outside the Great Wall to wait.

At this time, he had regained his ability to move, so he immediately asked all the demons to surrender.

Wang Shuo also asked all the soldiers to select suitable demon beasts from the demons as contracted pets.

Even the demon king has become a pet, and the other demon beasts dare not disobey.

A month later, Wang Shuo completely took over the territory of the Wagliang Empire.

But the demon beasts that originally occupied the Roland Empire, led by the demon king Miles, defected to the Roland Empire.

So far, the Wagliang Empire has completely collapsed, and the Dahuai Territory has barely gained a foothold in the Tiexue Ridge area.

In order to better control this large area, Wang Shuo and Zhao Bangde and others discussed and decided to temporarily use Tiexue City as the administrative center.

Tiexue City is located in the center of all territories, and all cities can be quickly teleported there.

There is no danger in the Dahuai Territory at present.

The enemy is only outside the Great Wall.

Therefore, it is necessary to place the main military forces in key cities such as Tiexue City.
